SAE_TRAIN.purpose: training-only feature statistics and group selection

coactivation.features: top 256 by training activation frequency; ties by index
coactivation.active_rows: count only strictly positive TopK values; ignore zero-valued tied slots

mechanism_categories.coupling_score: per feature, L2 over three semantic boundaries: ||kappa_F-kappa_M||2/(||kappa_F||2+||kappa_M||2+1e-8)
mechanism_categories.cuts: median activation and median coupling score over the 16384 features, computed on training rows only; high is strictly greater than median and low is less than or equal to median
mechanism_categories.output: four category counts per seed; no feature-name assignment

decision_coupling.class_pairs: all three pairwise semantic class boundaries

group_selection.ranking: descending absolute signed training mean of paired contribution delta; ties by feature index
group_selection.matching: greedy minimum Euclidean distance after training-pool z-score; feature-index tie break; no reuse
group_selection.dimensions_with_training_sd_below_floor: use scale 1.0 because the matching covariate is numerically constant

interventions.operation: zero selected sparse code entries, decode with frozen SAE, score unchanged native readout

prohibitions: SAE checkpoint selection by heldout results
